features.name: worktree-groups
features.purpose: Lets a worktree join a project group independently of its repo's own group membership, so cross-repo worktrees can share a sidebar section.

features.name: native-chat-relay
features.purpose: Reads and live-tails native-chat transcripts for an agent running on a plain ssh: host over the SSH relay, since the desktop process cannot see that host's disk.

features.name: native-chat-coloring
features.purpose: Renders native-chat tool calls with category glyphs/dots and syntax-highlighted code blocks instead of monochrome text.

features.name: native-chat-width
features.purpose: Lets the user pick the reading-column width for every native-chat pane instead of a fixed max-width.

'cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing' : 'cursor-pointer') while upstream replaced it with !(isDraggableRepoHeader || isDraggableProjectGroupHeader) && 'cursor-pointer', which is the shape this test asserts. Restoring this test and the grab-cursor shape must happen in the same commit that reduces WorktreeList.tsx to tag-plus-declared-seams (the worktree-groups extraction), not here.
